question.problem: After charging the battery of a PC, the percentage of charge decreases at a rate of $c(t)=100\cdot {5}^{-0.2t}$ percent per hour, where $t$ is the time, in hours, since the battery had completed its charge. What will be the rate of decrease after $5$ hours?
question.worked_solution:
Since we want to determine the rate of decrease in the amount of charge after $5$ hours, we have $t=5.$

Thus, the rate of decrease of the amount of charge after $5$ hours will be

$$
\begin{aligned}c(5) & =100\cdot {5}^{-0.2(5)} \\  & =100\cdot {5}^{-1} \\  & =\frac{100}{5} \\  & =20.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the rate of decrease will be $20$ percent per hour.

evidence.solution_quote: Therefore, the rate of decrease will be $20$ percent per hour.
